run.notes: 17 Nov China futures closes, Brent 17 Nov settlement and 18 Nov USDCNY fix found; no new dated material spot prices published since the previous payload; 4 new events; no forecasts (not Monday). Archive also retains rows from the earlier 18 Nov run.

events.title: Tanker near Hormuz struck a second time; Iran claims three ships hit mines
events.summary: UKMTO said a tanker hit on 16 Nov north of Khasab was struck again on 17 Nov with crew unaccounted for, and Iran claimed three ships hit mines near Hormuz; Brent traded around $92.9 early on 17 Nov.

events.title: China petrochemical futures fall 2-6% on 17 Nov
events.summary: Chinese crude futures fell over 6%; benzene over 4%; propylene, styrene and methanol over 3%; PX and palm oil over 2% on 17 Nov.

events.title: Goldman sees Brent averaging $88 in 2027 on returning surplus
events.summary: Goldman Sachs expects Brent to average $88/bbl in 2027 and fall to $78 by December 2027 as the market returns to surplus (as reported).

events.title: Houthis claim drone attack on two East-West pipeline pumping stations
events.summary: The Houthis said they fired five drones at two pumping stations on Saudi Arabia's East-West pipeline, the main route bypassing Hormuz; Brent nonetheless settled only $0.70 higher at $93.14 on 17 Nov as surplus expectations offset attacks.

events.title: Iranian drones target US radar site in Bahrain
events.summary: Iran's Revolutionary Guards fired drones at a US military radar system at Sheikh Isa base in Bahrain; Bahrain said the attack was intercepted, as Iran and Oman discussed protecting Hormuz shipping lanes.

events.title: TiPMC sees cautious TiO2 recovery as European capacity returns
events.summary: TiPMC's fall forecast puts 2027 global TiO2 demand at 7.61 Mt (+3.2%), notes ~310 kt/yr of former Venator sites in the UK, Spain and Italy returning under new owners, and sees continued chloride capacity growth in China.

events.title: PBOC sets strongest yuan fix since 2022
events.summary: The PBOC set the USD/CNY reference rate at 6.7118 on 18 Nov (vs 6.7132), its strongest fix since 2022, raising the USD cost of China-sourced raw materials at the margin.

analyses.summary: AI interpretation: No new dated China TiO2 price was published after the 17 Nov reading, which showed sulphate rutile still drifting lower in the off-season. TiPMC's fall outlook describes only a cautious recovery, with restarted European capacity and growing Chinese chloride output limiting upside into 2027. A slightly stronger yuan marginally lifts USD-denominated Chinese offers, but weak demand dominates near term.

drivers.name: Global capacity
drivers.note: ~310 kt/yr ex-Venator sites returning; China chloride growth

actions.action: Keep cover short; use returning European supply to test non-China offers for Q1.
Budget TiO2 flat to slightly lower for Q1, with a small FX allowance for CNY strength.

analyses.summary: AI interpretation: DCE styrene closed at 8,924 CNY/t on 17 Nov (-3.1%) with benzene down 4.3%, pointing to further easing in East China spot from the ~9,600 CNY/t reference. Brent edged up to $93.14 despite new attacks on the Saudi East-West pipeline and in Bahrain, showing the market is weighing surplus expectations above disruption. Upside risk stays tied to any escalation that cuts Middle East export routes.

drivers.name: Crude oil
drivers.note: Surplus outlook vs Middle East attacks

actions.action: Buy styrene and styrene-acrylic needs spot; avoid forward cover while futures fall.
Keep two-sided crude risk flagged in Q1 cost budgets.
